what: The plan persists EMERGENCY_REQUESTED only after Step 0/bootstrap, but larch:metadata is composed and posted inside bootstrap before the existing run-flags persist call.
scenario_or_breakage: An /implement --emergency run can post larch:metadata without Emergency: true, and a post-bootstrap persist cannot retroactively fix that already-upserted comment.
suggested_fix: Thread --emergency-requested into implement-bootstrap and post-tracking-issue.sh, include the Emergency line while summary-metadata.md is composed, and extend the existing bootstrap persist-implement-run-flags.sh call instead of adding a prompt-side post-bootstrap persist.

what: The plan updates only the template/contract for larch:final-summary, but the actual final-summary renderer does not read EMERGENCY_REQUESTED or accept/render an Emergency field.
scenario_or_breakage: Even if run-flags.sh contains EMERGENCY_REQUESTED=true, summary-final.md and the tracking issue larch:final-summary comment will omit Emergency: true.
suggested_fix: Update write-final-report.sh to read EMERGENCY_REQUESTED from run-flags.sh and pass it to render-run-summary.sh, then add a small render path that emits the Emergency line only when true.
